# Erica Remmele

> Senior product designer, senior UX/UI designer, creative director, and design engineer available for contract, freelance, or full-time remote work. United States–based, with Dallas and New York City as primary hubs.

Erica Remmele is a founding product designer and multidisciplinary creative who leads product UX/UI, design systems, brand, research, and design engineering for tech and creative teams. She partners with startups and enterprises across B2B and B2C. She is open to contract, freelance, and full-time remote opportunities.

Roles she is hired for include senior product designer, senior UX/UI designer, creative director, product manager, head of design, design researcher, brand designer, and design engineer. She is also trained in print and packaging design.

Industry experience spans tech, fashion, B2B, B2C, startups, AI (including generative and agentic systems), retail, sport and lifestyle, healthcare and wellness, music and entertainment, education, hospitality, and nonprofit.

Past collaborators include teams at Wieden+Kennedy, Nike, Abercrombie & Fitch, Universal Music, fashion startups, tech startups, and enterprise platforms.
